item.title: Girls State Basketball Tourney near its end, Johnston gets the 3-peat
item.description: DES MOINES, Iowa -- The Johnston Dragons took the 3-peat during the Girls State Basketball Tournament at the Casey's Center in downtown Des Moines. John Sears and David Warrington have the highlights from Friday's games.
